categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the manufacturing of key components for automation equipment transmission and braking systems, including precision transmission parts (such as expansion sleeves, flexible couplings, and synchronous pulleys), electromagnetic brakes (general, servo, and elevator brakes), and harmonic reducers. These products serve various automation equipment sectors like CNC machine tools, robots, elevators, wind power, and more.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies such as harmonic drive technology based on controllable elastic deformation, digital parameterized gear modeling, precision machining for thin-walled flexible wheels, and high-precision small module gear processing. It also innovates in electromagnetic brake design focusing on low noise, high vibration resistance, and adaptability to harsh environments, employing modular product development and advanced friction materials. Production follows a sales-driven model with lean management and proprietary information systems for production scheduling and quality control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading domestic and international enterprises in industrial automation, robotics, and elevator manufacturing, such as Inovance Technology, Estun Automation, Hitachi Elevator, Toshiba Elevator, Ringfeder Power Transmission, Tsubakimoto Chain, and Fenner. The company serves industries like CNC machining, robotics, elevators, wind power, automotive electric doors, and high-altitude work platforms, with products widely used in automation equipment requiring precise transmission and braking.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with significant domestic sales (over 76% of revenue) and exports primarily to Europe, the United States, and Japan. It has subsidiaries including J.M.S. Europe B.V. in the Netherlands, reflecting its international presence. The company is expanding overseas markets for electromagnetic brakes and continues to develop export business for precision transmission parts.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the research, development, manufacturing, and sales of key transmission and braking components for automation equipment. It procures raw materials and semi-finished parts upstream and sells finished components downstream to equipment manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include accelerating the construction of a comprehensive R&D center to enhance innovation capabilities, focusing on high-precision, intelligent, and integrated products such as servo brakes and harmonic reducers for robotics and elevators. The company emphasizes modular product development, lightweight and compact designs, and import substitution for high-end products. R&D projects target servo brakes, harmonic reducers, electromagnetic brakes for wind power and elevators, and new materials with flame retardant properties.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of products including electromagnetic brakes, precision transmission parts, and harmonic reducers. The company uses a direct sales model with OEM/ODM for precision transmission parts and proprietary brand sales for brakes and reducers. Revenue is recognized upon transfer of control to customers, typically at delivery or acceptance.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic manufacturer in the automation equipment transmission and braking components sector, competing with international brands that dominate high-end markets. It faces competition from foreign companies in high-precision fields like industrial robots and CNC machine tools but is gaining market share through technological innovation and import substitution. Major competitors include global transmission and brake component manufacturers such as Ringfeder, Tsubakimoto, and Fenner.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 615.85 million, a 5.24% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 100.89 million, up 4.46%. Total assets grew significantly by 61.10% to RMB 1.12 billion, and shareholders' equity nearly doubled to RMB 830.69 million. The company maintains a stable growth trajectory with expanding production capacity and R&D investment.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, precision, and reliability in its products, offering customized solutions with advanced technologies such as low-noise, high-precision harmonic reducers and electromagnetic brakes with long life and adaptability to harsh environments. Its integrated design, manufacturing, and testing capabilities, combined with strong customer relationships and a growing proprietary brand, differentiate it from competitors. The focus on import substitution and expanding into high-end markets further strengthens its competitive edge.
